## Claims
- [computed] For \(J=[333,5^5]\subset\Lambda/I_{5,5}\), \(Q=J/A_+J\) is torsion-free with \(\operatorname{rank}Q_{9+k}=[z^k]\binom52_z=(1,1,2,2,2,1,1)\) for \(0\le k\le6\), and \(Q_d=0\) for \(16\le d\le25\). [artifact b5658ec18b84ad470751544a752f238dadd447fb7b1122a89a299a79e024042f]
- [source-backed] The active stronger prediction is \(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}\); for \((a,b)=(2,3)\) this predicts \(\mathbb Z^{10}\). [source-6, lines 56-70]
- [source-backed] The lower-adjoined family \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\) is minimally generating. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 220-235]
- [proved] **Indecomposable-basis lemma.** Let \(A=\bigoplus_{d\ge0}A_d\) be a graded \(\mathbb Z\)-algebra with \(A_0=\mathbb Z\), let \(J\) be a graded ideal, and let \(G\subset J\) be a finite homogeneous generating set. If the residue classes of \(G\) are \(\mathbb Z\)-linearly independent in \(Q:=J/A_+J\), then they are a homogeneous \(\mathbb Z\)-basis of \(Q\). Consequently \(Q\) is torsion-free and \(\operatorname{Hilb}_Q(z)=\sum_{g\in G}z^{\deg g}\).
- [unsupported] Minimality of \(G\) alone does not imply the independence hypothesis of the indecomposable-basis lemma.

## Strategy
The computed ranks equal
\[
z^9(1+z+2z^2+2z^3+2z^4+z^5+z^6)
=z^9\binom52_z,
\]
exactly the rectangle \(3^2\) enumerator predicted by the stronger indecomposables statement; its coefficient sum is \(10=\binom52\).

Proof of the lemma: generation of \(J\) makes the images of \(G\) generate \(Q\), since every positive-degree coefficient vanishes modulo \(A_+J\). The assumed integral independence makes the resulting surjection \(\bigoplus_{g\in G}\mathbb Z[g]\twoheadrightarrow Q\) injective. Thus it is an isomorphism, yielding the stated Hilbert series and torsion-freeness.

The requested computation-to-theory synthesis target is established: the exact finite invariant is identified, matched to the predicted structure, and reduced to a reusable criterion. No universal identification of these residue classes as a basis is proved here.

## Gaps
The obstruction is that source-backed minimality only excludes deletion of a generator; it does not exclude nonprimitive relations in \(Q\). The minimal discriminating microcase is
\[
A=\mathbb Z[x],\qquad J=(2x,x^2).
\]
The two displayed generators are minimal, but
\[
J/A_+J=J/(xJ)\cong \mathbb Z\{2x\}\oplus(\mathbb Z/2)\{x^2\}.
\]
Hence minimality does not imply torsion-freeness or a free indecomposable basis.

## Next
A general stronger-structure proof must establish integral independence of the rectangle-indexed classes in \(J/A_+J\), not merely minimality.
